prompts: Use the provided fish sprite sheet as the polished 3D game style reference. Create a new transparent sprite atlas, extra wide horizontal 3:1 aspect ratio, exactly THREE EQUAL SQUARE CELLS left to right, all fish facing LEFT, mouth at exactly 6% of each cell width and 50% of cell height, tail near 94% of cell width. Center all fish identically. No text, no multiplier numbers, no water, no background, clean real alpha around the silhouettes. These are THREE DISTINCT fish, not one fish recolored. LEFT: LIL BLUES, a cute short rounded sapphire-blue ice fish with large dark eye, pearly belly, modest small triangular dorsal fin and small rounded tail. MIDDLE: BIG GREEN, a heavier deep emerald/lime fish with a broad angular head, much fuller belly, strong thick fins and a wider fan tail, visibly different head and body proportions. RIGHT: HUGE REDS, a long powerful scarlet/crimson fish with an elongated pointed snout, prominent sharp spiky dorsal fin, large forked tail, large strong side fins and silvery pale belly. Red fish should resemble the red fishing card in a premium ice fishing game, imposing compared with the blue. All three are glossy high-detail 3D rendered fish with reflective scales, coherent lighting from upper left, a readable silhouette at small sizes, natural curved body, no extra limbs or double heads. Each complete fish inside its own cell, preserve clear alpha margins. Side view, mouth is the shared animation attachment point, nose x=6% y=50%. Same camera direction, no perspective crop. Full fish, head and entire tail visible.

Edit ONLY transparency in this exact image. Remove the entire white/off-white background and pale halos around the three fish, making every non-fish pixel fully transparent alpha=0. It is a transparent sprite sheet, not a picture on white. Preserve all three fish exactly: pixel positions, size, shape, colors, lighting, face and fins. Preserve the pale silver BELLY inside each fish, do not erase it. Do NOT reposition or resize any fish; keep the exact 2172x724, 3 horizontal equal-square-cell arrangement. No shadows, no white rectangle, no checkerboard texture. Fully clear empty corners and clear space between fish. Only fish silhouettes have opacity.
